channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tim Hardaway | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tim Hardaway from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Steve Nash, Tim Hardaway
item.description:
Now a player he thought compared to other unconventional all-time greats he had drafted -- Steve Nash and Tim Hardaway -- had somehow fallen to his team at No. 33.

“All I know is he had the same things that Hardaway and Nash had -- heart, brains and balls,”

Donnie Nelson on Steve Nash, Tim Hardaway, Jun 8, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed
item.description:
“Tobias Harris, whom I've known for a long time. We've got Malik Beasley, Tim Hardaway Jr, and Paul Reed coming in. I feel very good about the offseason with the veterans. I think Trajan Langdon did a good job bringing the right people in, but still keeping flexibility.”

Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed, Oct 9, 2024. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Chris Mullin, Tim Hardaway, Mitch Richmond
item.description:
Pop on what Warriors' Run TMC - Tim Hardaway, Mitch Richmond & Chris Mullin - meant to the league:

“It was cool, it was fast-paced, it was creative, people really bought into it. It was a wonderful time in the NBA, and these guys were one of the best shows available for sure.”

Gregg Popovich on Chris Mullin, Tim Hardaway, Mitch Richmond, Nov 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Shannon Brown on Michael Finley, Tim Hardaway
item.description:
Having gone through similar camps when they were growing up in Maywood, the Browns understand what it means to young people to have the attention of NBA players.

“I remember going to Michael Finley's and Tim Hardaway's basketball camps and guys would come around and interact with us,”

Shannon Brown on Michael Finley, Tim Hardaway, Dec 30, 2019. Source: Forest Park Review.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Tim Hardaway
item.description:
Van Gundy told reporters Wednesday.

“Eleven games in for anybody is quick, but with all the success they had last year, yeah, I was pretty surprised. Tim Hardaway walked in my office and told me this morning and I was shocked. You don't expect that from a team that was in the final four last year and is really bringing back the same group.”

Stan Van Gundy on Tim Hardaway, Nov 18, 2015. Source: Booth Newspapers.
